notes: First execution of the headtohead suite (PR #370 machinery): 8 tasks x 4 arms x 5 attempts = 160 trials, 17h36m wall clock, $9.17 in reported provider subtotals covering 155 of 160 attempts (agentify 39/40, memorybank 38/40, serena 39/40, plain 39/40 costed; the 5 uncosted attempts are lost-telemetry provider_error failures counted against their own arms) of the $56.00 ceiling, agentify pinned to github:ixigo/agentify#fa2ba71, subscription OAuth, Serena via its documented uv install with the connection preflight. No attempt imported as a preflight abort (a zero-activity harness error), but the receipts cannot positively prove a connected server for every trial — one Serena attempt died after ~9h with no telemetry, indistinguishable from a degraded run, and is counted as a Serena failure (conservative). Whether agents CALLED Serena's tools is not measured by harbor imports — disclosed. Findings, stated plainly: (1) vs plain Claude Code, agentify 36/40 vs 26/40, pooled discordant 10/0 across 3 task families at exact sign p=0.00195 — a strong directional result whose pooled Wilson intervals still overlap at 5 attempts per task, so the fail-closed rule declares no winner yet. (2) vs Serena, 36/40 vs 27/40, discordant 9/0 — the free LSP code-intelligence competitor does not recover the seeded knowledge even when it sits in native .serena/memories (0/5 on avoid-cache-regression). (3) vs the CLAUDE.md memory-bank stuffing arm: a statistical TIE — memorybank 37/40 vs agentify 36/40, discordant 3/2 in memorybank's favor, (cost telemetry is incomplete — agentify 39/40 and memorybank 38/40 attempts reported cost — so no cheaper-arm conclusion is drawn). At this suite's tiny fixture size (a handful of notes), stuffing everything into context is competitive; budgeted retrieval's advantage must come from store SCALE, which this suite does not yet test — a store-size ladder is the designed follow-up. Published per our own guardrail: a competitor arm matching Agentify is a finding to commit and act on, not to bury. No multi-arm suite-level tool verdict exists yet (the #322 rule engine is pairwise/grid-based); the pooled discordant counts above are per-run report sums, receipts attached.
